title: regulatory-impact-assessment
description: Structured second-line impact assessment for a published rule, supervisory letter, FIL, circular, bulletin, industry letter, adopting release, advisory, supervisory speech, or enforcement theme. Carries both an implementation lens (in-scope determination, obligation domains, policy and control impact, reporting and disclosure impact, technology and data impact, third-party impact, customer impact, cost-to-comply, effective-date posture) and a regulatory-strategy lens (firm position, regulator-engagement posture, comment-period posture, peer-and-industry alignment, escalation triggers). Audience: regulatory affairs, head of compliance, head of legal, CRO chief of staff, head of business affected. Drafts only; attestation external.

assessment_id.description: Stable ID for the impact assessment. Reused across all artifacts produced for the same regulatory item.

engagement_id.description: Optional pointer to the scope record this assessment was produced under.

as_of_date.description: Date the assessment was last revised.

decision_required.description: What the assessment is asking the named lead or decision body to decide. Examples: ingest the item into the regulatory-change inventory and kick off rule-to-obligation-extraction; sign a comment letter; escalate to the CRO; defer the strategy posture pending legal review.

recommended_posture.description: Brief recommended posture summary across the implementation and strategy lenses.

source_citation.description: Pinpoint regulatory source. The rest of the assessment cites against this block.

regulator.description: Issuing regulator. Examples: OCC, FRB, FDIC, NCUA, CFPB, SEC, FINRA, FinCEN, OFAC, NYDFS, state DOI, state banking department, NAIC, foreign supervisor, interagency.

regulator_office.description: Specific office or division (e.g., OCC Large Bank Supervision; SEC Division of Investment Management; CFPB Office of Innovation; NYDFS Cybersecurity Division).

instrument_type.description: What kind of instrument the assessment is reading. Drives the strategy lens.

citation.description: The pinpoint citation. CFR pin, SR or bulletin number, FIL number, circular number, Industry Letter date, release number, advisory number, speech URL and date, enforcement order ID.

section.description: Section reference if applicable. Use [verify section] when the section reference cannot be confirmed at the time of assessment.

effective_date.description: Mandatory compliance date for a final rule, where applicable.

comment_period_close_date.description: For a proposed rule, the comment period close date.

related_instruments.description: Cross-references to related instruments (the proposed rule that preceded the final, the FAQ that updated the bulletin, the speech that signalled the priority).

in_scope.description: Whether the firm is in scope for the rule. False with rationale required.

in_scope_rationale.description: Why the firm is or is not in scope, with source pin. Required when in_scope is false; recommended when in_scope is true.

scope.description: Detailed in-scope determination across institution, products, business units, geographies, and thresholds.

institution_types.description: Institution-type determination. Examples: national bank, state member bank, state non-member bank, BHC, IDI, NCUA-supervised credit union, SEC-registered investment adviser, registered fund, broker-dealer, transfer agent, MSB, state-licensed money transmitter, state-chartered insurer, fintech under sponsor-bank arrangement, FBO US operations.

thresholds_named.description: Where the rule names an asset-size, AUM, transaction-volume, or activity-volume threshold, the threshold and the firm's read against it.

threshold_text.description: The threshold as the rule states it.

firm_read.description: Whether the firm crosses the threshold and the basis.

partial_applicability_note.description: Where the rule applies in part (e.g., 1071 partial applicability based on origination volume), the part the rule covers and the part it does not.

sunset_or_contingency.description: Sunset clauses, Congressional Review Act dependency, judicial review status, agency-rulemaking-implementation contingency.

early_adoption_posture.description: Where the firm is considering early compliance, the posture and rationale.

affected_obligation_domains.description: High-level obligation domains the rule touches. Hooks for downstream rule-to-obligation-extraction.

existing_obligation_refs.description: Obligation-inventory IDs the impact assessment overlays prior items on (chains to obligation-mapping).

policy_impact.description: Policies and procedures likely needing amendment. The skill names the surface area; policy-diff and the firm's policy authoring process draft the language.

policy_area.description: Named policy area (e.g., third-party risk management policy; information security policy; model risk policy; AML CDD procedures; advertising and marketing review procedures).

control_impact.description: Control objectives potentially affected. Control objective, not control instance.

anticipated_evidence_gap.description: Areas where the rule's evidence expectation likely exceeds current state.

reporting_impact.description: Regulatory reports, public disclosures, and board reporting affected.

report_or_disclosure.description: Report name or disclosure surface. Examples: Call Report Schedule RC-X; Form ADV Part 2A; Form 10-K Item 1.05; CFPB 1071 register; FinCEN SAR; NAIC annual statement; privacy notice; adverse-action notice; AI-use disclosure.

technology_data_impact.description: Systems of record, data lineage, and model inventory implications.

system_or_data_area.description: Examples: core banking, loan origination, deposit operations, claims management, policy administration, trading and execution, custody, transfer agent, model platform, vendor management system, complaints database.

new_data_field.description: Where the rule introduces a new data field, the field name and its source.

customer_impact.description: Customer-facing changes. Plain language; the failure mode is technical jargon that obscures the customer touch.

cost_to_comply.description: Indicative cost-to-comply read. Calibrates against agency cost-and-benefit analyses prepared under OMB Circular A-4 but does not adopt them as ground truth without firm-side validation.

indicative_range.description: Indicative range with a basis note.

basis.description: Peer benchmark, vendor estimate, similar prior project, agency RIA, firm-side estimate.

items.description: Named cost drivers (policy refresh, control build-out, technology change, vendor remediation, training, communication, testing, monitoring, reporting, governance overhead).

agency_estimate_reference.description: Where the agency has published a cost-and-benefit analysis under OMB Circular A-4 or an agency-specific RIA, the reference and the firm's read against it.

regulatory_strategy.description: The strategy lens. Firm position, engagement posture, comment-period posture, public consultation posture, peer alignment, escalation triggers.

owner_role.description: Internal owner for the comment letter draft.

draft_pathway.description: Coordination with industry associations, internal review path, board-or-committee approval gate.

public_consultation_posture.description: Testimony, press posture, public statement (rare and counsel-set).

peer_industry_alignment.description: Where the firm reads the industry consensus, where it diverges, and what that divergence implies for engagement strategy.

items.description: Named association (BPI, ABA, ICBA, SIFMA, ICI, IAA, ACLI, NAFCU, MBA, others).

escalation_triggers.description: Thresholds at which the item moves from regulatory-change-committee to CRO, GC, executive committee, board risk committee, full board.

open_questions.description: Items requiring qualified review before the assessment closes. Each question is routed to an owner role and tied to what it blocks downstream.

next_step.description: Examples: kick off rule-to-obligation-extraction; run policy-diff against named policy areas; commission implementation-plan; engage external counsel on strategy lens; refine cost-to-comply with finance partner; consult head of business on operating-model implication.

review_gates.description: Named human-review gates this assessment must clear before downstream skills run.

human_review_required.description: Always true. The skill stops at draft; the named lead attests.

confidence_label.description: Overall confidence label. A single overall label hides variance; recommend per-section confidence in source_trace as well.

source_trace.description: Citations supporting material claims about the rule, the in-scope read, the impact area, the cost-to-comply, and the strategy posture.
